title: Quarantine repeated network worker same-reason failures
summary: Implement A4 from the network worker hardening plan by suppressing repeated same worker/source/reason redispatch loops and surfacing worker misconfiguration evidence.
reason: A misconfigured worker can repeatedly claim the same inaccessible source and fail quickly; the coordinator needs bounded retry suppression and a clear alert instead of infinite same-reason redispatch.
behavior_before: Coordinator claim selection did not remember repeated same-reason worker failures, so a worker with bad path/auth/URL state could re-claim the same work repeatedly.
behavior_after: Coordinator claim selection will skip worker/source pairs that have reached the configured same-reason failure threshold and will emit/read back structured quarantine evidence.
